extraction_method: vector-path extraction of the black central final WIMP-search ROI curve and gray uncertainty-envelope polygon
uncertainty_envelope_interpretation: The gray Fig. S2 envelope is retained as a detector-efficiency systematic range; the publication does not assign a confidence level to the envelope.
digitization_note: The central vector curve gives a low-energy 50% crossing near 5.09 keV, whereas the paper text/caption quotes 5.4 keV from Ref. [5]. The central high-energy crossing near 269.87 keV agrees with 269.9 keV. The central mean final-ROI efficiency over 14--250 keV is 95.47%, about 0.53 percentage points below the rounded published 96%; the curve is not rescaled. The gray uncertainty envelope is also digitized.
